setting: 2回目のデート。Miaは先に店に着いて、窓際の席でLeoを待っていた。Leoが着いて席に座った直後。
lyrics:
[Intro]
(I keep trying to impress you)
(I don't know what I got myself into with you)

[Verse 1]
You said you like window shopping, try before you buy
You got me losing sleep, I've got no appetite
We keep trying to talk it out, but all the words don't count
When you look at me there's nervous energy

[Pre-Chorus]
Why did I buy this dress?
I've got my hair done up
You said you liked me in red so I wore just a touch
Now you've got something that seems to mess me up
I think I care too much
Why do I care so much now?

[Chorus]
I keep trying to impress you
I don't know why that is, but I have to
You'd never know that I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you
You keep coming back around
I'm nervous just to let you down
I don't know who I am when I'm with you
'Cause I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into

[Verse 2]
Pull up at the restaurant, you say it's been too long
Now I'm kinda stressed, I think I'm overdressed
But I'd love it if you noticed all the effort that I've focussed on tonight
(And every other night)

[Pre-Chorus]
I know I look my best
I've got my hair done up
You said you liked me in red
So I wore just a touch

[Chorus]
I keep trying to impress you
I don't know why that is, but I have to
You'd never know that I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you
You keep coming back around
I'm nervous just to let you down
I don't know who I am when I'm with you
'Cause I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you

[Bridge]
Na-na-na-na-na-na
Na-na-na-na-na-na
I don't know, I don't know, I don't know, I don't know
I don't know who I am with you
Na-na-na-na-na-na
Na-na-na-na-na-na
I don't know, I don't know, I don't know, I don't know
I don't know who I am with you

[Chorus]
I keep trying to impress you
I don't know why that is, but I have to
You'd never know that I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you
You keep coming back around
I'm nervous just to let you down
I don't know who I am when I'm with you
'Cause I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you

[Outro]
(I keep trying to impress you)
(I don't know what I got myself in—)

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I changed outfits three times before coming here.
sentences.displayHtml: I changed outfits three times before coming here.

sentences.text: I think I care too much.
sentences.displayHtml: I think I care too much.

conversation.japanese: ここに来る前に、服を三回も着替えたの。気にしすぎだよね。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: You look great, but you don't have to work so hard for this date.
sentences.displayHtml: You look great, but you don't have to work so hard for this date.

conversation.japanese: すごく似合ってるよ。でも、このデートのためにそんなに頑張らなくていい。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I keep trying to impress you.
sentences.displayHtml: I keep trying to impress you.

sentences.text: I was nervous we'd run out of things to say.
sentences.displayHtml: I was nervous we'd run out of things to say.

conversation.japanese: つい、よく思われようとしちゃう。話題がなくなったらって緊張してた。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I'd love it if you just told me about your day.
sentences.displayHtml: I'd love it if you just told me about your day.

conversation.japanese: 普通に今日のことを聞かせてくれたらうれしい。試験じゃないんだから。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Then let me tell you about the disaster I had at work today.
sentences.displayHtml: Then let me tell you about the disaster I had at work today.

conversation.japanese: わかった。じゃあ、今日仕事で大失敗した話を聞いて。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Let's order some food, and you can tell me everything.
sentences.displayHtml: Let's order some food, and you can tell me everything.

conversation.japanese: 気になるな。料理を頼んで、全部聞かせて。

lyricConnections.lyricExpression: I keep trying to impress you
lyricConnections.conversationExpression: I keep trying to impress you
lyricConnections.explanationJa: keep trying to ... は、繰り返しそうしようとすること。impress は好印象を与えること。
I'd love it if you ... は、そうしてもらえたらうれしいという柔らかい希望。
